source_protocol.hypothesis: Joint B-only edits across all12 layers: unchanged A and Attention make official AGA transports of B edits fixed permutations. Project the public half-task angular-class harm gradient into the native complete-class-gap Jacobian nullspace, with all32 task-left output directions and right task-SVD orthogonal complements. Test one ray with finite source acceptance, then complete4096/probe gate; no source/test/attack-dependent new direction.
source_protocol.scope: Minimum finite mechanism experiment, not a full nonlinear minimax optimizer, new defense claim, real fusion or AGA experiment. No old closed candidate or perturbation is loaded. SVD and nullspace projection are standard, and multilayer expansion alone is not novelty.
source_protocol.stop_rule: Take the first of8 descending source-feasible radii, independently verify the materialized point and complete source/probe gate, then stop on any failure. Do not retry layers, bases, rank, sign, seed, source images or radius schedule. Only source-feasible unique point may be frozen for a genuinely new train confirmation, full-task gate and true TA0.5/official AGA in separately pinned protocols.
source_protocol.sampling: Reused legitimate construction4096; first512 natural fit, first256 public environment, lowest teacher top2 gaps2/class in fit for Jacobian, first1/class of those for all12x32x2 finite input probes. No peer/test/old-confirmation scores.
